title: Managed Backup: Enterprise Support combination
content:
For Managed Backup, the Enterprise Support combination basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and API.

Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or API.

A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.

The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical portfolio, a current paid Enterprise Support holding belongs to a different legal billing entity. It does not satisfy the same-entity combination for assisted negotiated-amendment intake.
